min.description: The minimum value for the progress bar range, corresponding to 0% completion.

max.description: The maximum value for the progress bar range, corresponding to 100% completion.

width.description: The width of the progress bar in columns.

percentage.description: Whether to show the percentage completed.

style.description: The rendering style of the progress bar.

label.description: A label displayed at the beginning of the progress bar.

elapsed.description: Whether to show the elapsed time.

estimate.description: Whether to show the estimated remaining time.

sleep_interval.description: Seconds to sleep between progress updates, simulating work.
